Kareena Kapoor's Film 'Daayra' Box Office Collection Reported

The film 'Daayra', starring Kareena Kapoor Khan and Prithviraj Sukumaran, had its first-day box office collection reported across various outlets. Figures cited range from ₹90 Lakh to ₹1.15 Crore. One report indicated the film received a disappointing opening, while another highlighted it as a must-watch. The film's plot has been described as laying bare a fractured justice system.
